page.title: Corpus
page.purpose: Browse live collections and content-addressed documents with privacy, federation, and processing locality visible in the default view.

priorities.statement: Privacy and federation policy are visible on every collection row.
Document identity and processing locality are visible without opening a document.
Empty and error states explain whether the corpus is empty or unavailable.

states.description: Collections and documents are loaded from the corpus API.
The API is reachable but has no collections or documents.
The corpus API failed and the error is visible.

claims.statement: The corpus page exposes a named region with collections and documents.
A document's privacy class is visible in the document list.
Document processing locality is conveyed by a readable label in the list.
The corpus lists expose their labels to assistive technology in normal document order.
Populated, empty, and error states are distinct.
